title: Buffer checklist for SELEX
body:
### 1. Buffer checklist for SELEX
	
- 10X HT-SELEX (1.55X) Buffer		
- 10X HT-SELEX (1X) Buffer		
- **Nucleosome Dilution Buffer**	
- **Refolding Buffer**					
- **TF Dilution Buffer (NCAP-SELEX)**	
- NCAP-SELEX Elution Buffer		
- **Biotin Elution Buffer**	
- 10X TCAPT Buffer		
- **TCAPT Block Buffer**
- Sol1 Salt Buffer		
- Blocking Buffer Salt-Free		
- 1X Wash Buffer (NCAP)	[just before Wash step]
- 0.5X Wash Buffer (NCAP) [just before Wash step]

*Buffers in bold have already been prepared freshly*
*Refolding Buffer prepared is from the last batch in Aug 2026*		

*TF Dilution Buffer*

500 mL

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| 1 M Tris-HCl pH 8 | 5 mL |
| BSA | 0.5 g |
| KCl| 5.59 g |
| Ethylene Glycol | 250 mL |
| 100 mM ZnSO4.H2O | 50 uL |

	
*Blocking Buffer Salt-free*

25mM Tris, 0.5% BSA, 0.1% tween, 0.02% NaN3 pH8 [1000 mL buffer]

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| 1 M Tris pH 8 | 25 mL |
| BSA | 5 g |
| Tween20| 1 mL |
| Ethylene Glycol | 250 mL |
| NaN3 (10%) | 2 mL |

0.02% = 0.1 g

*Elution Buffer*
0.1% Tween, 10 mM Tris pH7.8, 1 mM MgCl2 (0.5mM in PCR rxn)

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tween20 | 500 uL |
| 1 M Tris pH 8 | 5 mL |
| 1M MgCl2| 500 uL |

*10X Buffer (for 1.55X SELEX buffer) [HT-SELEX]*
250 mL
| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| 1 M Tris pH 7.5 | 50 mL |
| KCl | 14.35 g |
| 1M MgCl2| 2.5 mL |
| Glycerol| 100 mL |

*10X Buffer (for 1X SELEX buffer) [HT-SELEX]*
250 mL
| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| 1 M Tris pH 7.5 | 50 mL |
| KCl | 13.98 g |
| 1M MgCl2| 2.5 mL |
| Glycerol| 100 mL |
